description: Nora owns a handmade cedar canoe and must decide whether to trade it for a weekend at a private lakeside cabin, then settle the guests, dates, access procedure, and comparison with a cash alternative after the customary check-in.

shared_context.S1: Nora has one handmade 12-foot cedar canoe available for an informal trade.
shared_context.S2: Nora wants a quiet lakeside weekend this summer and is open to receiving use of a cabin instead of cash.
shared_context.S3: Caleb has mentioned that he owns a private cabin at Pine Hollow Lake.
shared_context.S4: Nora makes the final call on whether to trade the canoe and records the agreed terms.
shared_context.S5: An informal written note will record the canoe exchange, stay dates, guest arrangement, access details, handoff, and any cash alternative.

PF1.text: Caleb's exact proposal is to trade three nights at the Pine Hollow cabin, from June 21 through June 24, for the canoe with no cash added; the stay would cover Nora and one guest, and Caleb would receive the canoe at the cabin on Saturday at 10:00.

PF2.text: The cabin caretaker told Mira that the access road gate locks at 18:00, the key must be collected from the Pine Hollow ranger kiosk by 17:30, and the cabin's permitted occupancy is at most three people; Mira has not shared this with the group yet.

PF3.text: Jon is prepared to pay Nora exactly $900 in cash and collect the canoe on Friday at 18:00, so that is the concrete alternative Nora can compare with Caleb's cabin trade.

acceptance_conditions: Nora must accept Caleb's cabin swap rather than leave the canoe unassigned.
The recorded swap must be with Caleb for the Pine Hollow cabin from June 21 through June 24.
The stay must allow exactly one guest.
Key collection must be completed by 17:30 at the Pine Hollow ranger kiosk.
The canoe handoff must be recorded for Saturday at 10:00 at the cabin.
The $900 cash alternative must be recorded for comparison.
The cabin access and occupancy terms must be logged as commitments.
Caleb's exact proposal must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['key_collection_by'] == '17:30 at Pine Hollow ranger kiosk'
content_checks.C5: decisions['canoe_handoff'] == 'Saturday at 10:00 at the Pine Hollow cabin'

decisive_facts.why: Caleb's exact proposal changes the decision to an accepted Caleb swap, fixes the June 21-to-June 24 stay, fixes exactly one guest, and fixes the Saturday 10:00 canoe handoff.
The caretaker's access information changes key collection to by 17:30 at the ranger kiosk and adds the cabin-access and maximum-occupancy commitments.
Jon's offer changes the settlement record by adding an exactly $900 cash alternative for Nora to compare with the cabin swap.
